summary: Missing hiker on Mt. Lindsey; Costilla County SAR requested AVSAR leadership assistance; AVSAR supported with operations planning by phone only and deployed no personnel or resources; outcome of the operation was not reported to AVSAR.
notes: 2010-08-05 Thursday-verified. AVSAR role was phone ops-planning support only (no AVSAR deployment); outcome not reported to AVSAR, so outcome=assist per row convention.
